name: Ferienpension Ritter & Kögl
beschreibung:
Quietly nestled in the idyllic Thiersee valley, the family-run Pension Ritter & Koegl welcomes visitors with authentic Tyrolean warmth. Pleasantly appointed rooms invite deep relaxation amidst intact natural scenery.

Nearby Lake Thiersee promises refreshing swims in summer, while hiking paths ascending Mount Pendling start close by. Winter brings quiet snowshoe trails and well-tended cross-country tracks.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienpension Ritter & Koegl in Thiersee offers comfortable rooms and a warm family atmosphere in scenic Kufsteinerland.
